title: Line 2 packaging label registration recovery
summary: Recovery procedure for LABEL-DRIFT on the CP-2200 secondary packaging case packer on Line 2 at the Riverton plant.
content: Confirm case index marks are aligned with the label sensor before restarting the line. Set the side register to +0.6 mm and re-center the carton guide. Run a 12-pack validation before returning to the full-speed mode, and inspect the film feed tension if the drift repeats.

title: Carton jam clearance and lockout
summary: Required steps for clearing a carton jam while preventing conveyor restart hazards on the secondary packer.
content: Place the line in safe stop, verify the carryway is below 0.3 m/s, and use lockout/tagout before opening the guard. Remove material with hand tools only, and never reach across the transfer section until the E-stop reset test passes.

title: Line 2 glue bead and seam check standard
summary: Inspection and maintenance standard to keep the glue bead profile stable during medium-rate packaging runs.
content: Inspect the glue bead width every 45 minutes during a standard run. If bead spread exceeds 1.8 mm, reduce speed by 10% and verify nozzle temperature remains within 42-46C. Replace the applicator tip whenever the bead edge shows scalloping for two consecutive checks.
